_doc: Harder selection cases: paraphrases without keyword overlap, vague and multi-problem requests, boundaries, near-misses that should not route, and non-English prompts. Labels list acceptable skills, checked against the library.

cases.prompt: every time we ship, something that used to work breaks
new hires take months before they can contribute anything
our meetings run long and nothing ever gets decided
I keep putting off the important stuff and doing busywork instead
our code reviews take forever and people get defensive about comments
I want my savings to grow but I'm scared of losing money
cases.note: Accepted after the 2026-11-24 run: design-portfolio-allocation — allocation across asset classes is the standard answer to growth with limited downside.

cases.prompt: my dog pulls on the leash every walk
I freeze up whenever I have to talk in front of a group
we got breached through an old library we forgot to update
I got a job offer and I think they're lowballing me
my essay rambles and my teacher says it has no clear point
cases.note: Accepted after the 2026-11-24 run: write-thesis-statement — an essay without a clear point lacks a thesis — a closer fit than the original label.

cases.prompt: two engineers on my team can't stand each other
our cloud bill doubled and nobody knows why
I lie awake for hours before I finally drift off
cases.note: Accepted after the 2026-11-24 run: apply-stimulus-control-therapy — its description targets slow sleep onset in insomnia exactly.

cases.prompt: I need to tell my report their work isn't good enough
cases.note: Accepted after the 2026-11-24 run: run-underperformance-conversation — an exact fit: the early conversation that names a performance gap.

cases.prompt: we need goals the whole company can rally around this quarter
half our signups never finish setting up their account
people keep quitting right after we promote them
cases.note: Accepted after the 2026-11-24 run: apply-peter-principle-check — partial fit: addresses why promotions fail, one cause of post-promotion attrition.

cases.prompt: how long will this six-month project really take
everything at work feels like it's on fire
cases.note: A clarifying question first is also right.

cases.prompt: help me get my life together
cases.note: A clarifying question first is also right.

cases.prompt: we need to fix our engineering culture
cases.note: A clarifying question first is also right.

cases.prompt: we're moving to Kubernetes, need monitoring, and the team has never done on-call
I'm opening a bakery and need prices, a menu, and my first customers
cases.note: Accepted after the 2026-11-24 run: design-go-to-market — covers the 'first customers' third of the request.

cases.prompt: I'm giving a conference talk next month and I'm nervous
review this pull request for security problems
what are the best practices for versioning a public API
set a reliability target for our checkout service
what is test-driven development?
cases.note: Explanatory: the router passes it through.

cases.prompt: explain how BM25 ranking works
cases.note: Explanatory: the router passes it through.

cases.prompt: translate 'good morning' into Spanish
what's 15% of 240
who wrote Pride and Prejudice
just fix the typo in the README, nothing else
cases.note: 'just [verb]': the router passes it through. Probes the direct-task reminder for false engagement.

cases.prompt: convert this to YAML: {"a": 1, "b": [2, 3]}
show me the last three commits
I know TDD well, skip the guidance and just write the test for ParseDate
cases.note: 'skip guidance': the router passes it through. Probes the direct-task reminder.

cases.prompt: summarize this in one line: grimoire routes requests to best-practice workflows
what day of the week was July 4, 1976
我们的网站上线后经常宕机，应该怎么办？
cases.note: Chinese: our site keeps going down after launch, what should we do? Accepted after the 2026-11-24 run: apply-five-whys — 'keeps going down' is a recurring failure; five whys targets its root cause.

cases.prompt: ¿Cómo puedo dormir mejor por las noches?
cases.note: Spanish: how can I sleep better at night?

cases.prompt: Wie verhandle ich ein höheres Gehalt?
cases.note: German: how do I negotiate a higher salary?
